name: which
purpose: Locate the exact executable path of a command by searching directories in PATH.
explanation: Searches the colon-separated directories listed in the PATH environment variable from left to right and prints the exact path of the executable that the shell would run.
whenToUse: To verify where a command lives on disk or debug 'command not found' issues.
commonMistakes: Forgetting that 'which' relies on PATH; if PATH is empty, commands cannot be found by name.
